page.layout: One page of text in one column. Running text at the top, then a block of Arabic-script lines set in the body, then the heading "SECT." at the right. The lower part of the page holds only faint show-through from the reverse side, which is left out. No marginal notes.

reliquis verò eandem literam inferné minori formâ, at He finali aliud interdum superponitur indicans absentiam punctorum supradictorum: hœc autem alii omittunt, ut merè superfluum & inane Grammaticorum figmentum; absentia enim punctorum satis has literas distinguit ab aliis similibus quæ punctis afficiuntur, scil. â
main_text.head: SECT.

page.notes: The text is printed mostly in Latin with Arabic-script letters set in the body. The Arabic lines are only partly legible, so the letters are marked as illegible. Small "v" marks sit above the first Arabic line, and dots sit above the second, as diacritics. The page number "(62)" is partly faint. Long s has been replaced by s throughout. The ligature œ in "hœc" is kept as printed. Show-through from the reverse side in the lower half is not transcribed.
